name: 80 kg rider standing 100 mm off centre, fresh water
notes: The standing-stability case: heel and trim are both free, so the board finds its own attitude rather than being assumed upright. 100 mm is a small weight shift, not a lunge. Rider CG height is still a guess and dominates this result, so measure it before drawing conclusions.

loads.notes: Standing CG assumed roughly 1 m above the culm axes, displaced to starboard.
